headline: French high school students resume blockades and protests
summary: French high school students gathered in front of schools in Paris to resume nationwide blockades and protests demanding better educational conditions.
why: Civil unrest and nationwide student strikes impact local commerce, public transit efficiency, and consumer confidence in major European urban centers.

impacts.name: France
impacts.why: Student blockades and protests impact public order in Paris.
